segments.text: That meeting invite just popped up and your focus is already gone.
Your heart rate spikes because you think it's an emergency you have to answer right now.
Here is the loop: you see the invite, you panic, and you accept it instantly.
You lose your deep work time just to prove you are available.
The Stoic move is simple: withhold your assent.
When the invite hits, do not say yes immediately.
Ask yourself, does this serve the work I am doing now, or just the ego of the sender?
If it is not critical, decline it or schedule it for later.
You are not ignoring them; you are protecting your judgment.
Control what you can: your time.
Accept what you cannot: their urgency.
Do you accept every invite, or do you pause?
